name: Deepmoss Spider Eggs
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. narrative.details:
Spider egg omelettes are a new fad in Booty Bay!  The problem is... Booty Bay's got no eggs.

I smell an opportunity!

In Windshear Crag and Sishir Canyon, in the Stonetalon Mountains to the northwest, lives the deepmoss spider.  Bring me its eggs and I'll pay a bundle!

In Windshear Crag, the eggs will be clustered under what trees remain.

In Sishir Canyon... well, if you have a weak stomach then maybe you should just collect the eggs at Windshear Crag...
narrative.objectives: Bring 15 Deepmoss Eggs to Mebok Mizzyrix in Ratchet.
narrative.offerRewardText:
You got them! Thank you!

I'll have these sent to Dizzywig and get them shipped to Booty Bay. I can already taste the profits!

Here is your cut, adventurer. I couldn't have made this deal without you.
narrative.requestItemsText: Did you get the eggs, adventurer? I already made a shipping deal with Wharfmaster Dizzywig!
